description:
Search the NobleBlocks index of scholarly papers by keyword relevance, with filters.

        Each result has title, authors, year, journal, DOI, citation count, an abstract excerpt,
        a NobleBlocks link and `best_link` (free full text when known, else the DOI/ARK).
        Use get_paper with a result's `id` for full metadata, or cite to cite it.

limit.description: Number of results (1-50; your access tier may cap it lower).
limit.title: Limit

min_citations.description: Only papers cited at least this many times.
min_citations.title: Min Citations

query.description: Topic, question, title words or author name. Supports AND / OR / NOT and "quoted phrases".
query.title: Query

year_from.description: Only records published in or after this year.
year_from.title: Year From

year_to.description: Only records published in or before this year.
year_to.title: Year To

name: search_papers
title: Search papers
